appraisal_events.evidence: elle me l'avait passé en me disant : « Faites attention qu'on ne voie pas. » ... « Je vous aime bien. »
appraisal_events.explanation: Albertine secretly passes the narrator a note declaring affection while asking that Andrée and Rosemonde not see it, staging his inclusion in a private, favored intimacy within the group.

status_effects.explanation: The secret note of affection gives the narrator a private, elevated emotional standing with Albertine, distinct from the group's shared banter.

ambiguities: The narrator's comparison of Mme de Villeparisis and Saint-Loup ('je les quittais avec fatigue') to the jeunes filles reads as essayistic reflection on the nature of friendship rather than a staged local event, so neither was scored.
